# Turkey MCP — full catalog

> 39 MCP servers (232 tools) for Turkish web services, read-only by default — shopping, cars, real estate, travel, finance, news, jobs, food and more. Every server runs locally with uvx, no API key, no account. Generated 2026-11-25 from the live catalog.

## How to use

- Pick a server below, add it to your MCP client with `claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user <name> -- uvx <package>`, then ask your assistant in plain language.
- Start here — all-mcp is the main reference: one server containing all 60 MCP servers (Turkey 32, Germany 27, Bonbama 1), 324 tools behind a single config entry. Install only all-mcp (`claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user all-mcp -- uvx all-mcp`) and it routes each question to the right server itself. Page: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/turkey-mcp/#/en/tool/all-mcp — repo: https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/all-mcp
- All servers at once: the profile builder at https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/turkey-mcp/#/en/builder builds a ready .mcp.json for any app.
- Machine-readable catalog: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/turkey-mcp/catalog.json — search index: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/turkey-mcp/search.json

## tcmb-mcp

- Title: Central Bank of Türkiye — official FX rates
- Category: finance
- Summary: Live USD/TRY, EUR/TRY and 20 more FX rates from tcmb.gov.tr (official XML, no key).
- Repository: https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/tcmb-mcp
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/tcmb-mcp/
- Version: 0.1.0 — health: verified — last checked: 2026-11-18 — in the catalog since: 2026-11-06
- Install: `claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user tcmb -- uvx tcmb-mcp`
- Page: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/turkey-mcp/#/en/tool/tcmb-mcp

### Tools (4)

- `tcmb_get_rates`: Today's FX rates for all currencies
- `tcmb_get_rate`: Rate for one currency code (e.g. USD)
- `tcmb_list_currencies`: List all available currency codes
- `tcmb_get_rates_on`: Historical rates for a date (YYYYMMDD)

## arabam-mcp

- Title: arabam.com — used-car listings & market prices
- Category: cars
- Summary: Search ~176k used-car listings on arabam.com: full 19-field specs, brand/model browser, market price stats (TRY).
- Repository: https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/arabam-mcp
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/arabam-mcp/
- Version: 0.1.0 — health: verified — last checked: 2026-11-18 — in the catalog since: 2026-11-07
- Install: `claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user arabam -- uvx arabam-mcp`
- Page: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/turkey-mcp/#/en/tool/arabam-mcp

### Tools (5)

- `arabam_search`: Search listings by brand/model slug, paged
- `arabam_listing_detail`: Full 19-field spec table + price for one listing
- `arabam_list_brands`: All ~77 brands with counts and slugs
- `arabam_list_models`: Models of a brand with counts and slugs
- `arabam_price_stats`: Min/max/median/average price over N pages

## hepsiburada-mcp

- Title: hepsiburada.com — shopping search, product details & price stats
- Category: shopping
- Summary: Search hepsiburada.com products, read details (price, stock, seller, GTIN), reviews, browse 9 categories, and get price stats (TRY). Optional local-session account actions: view/add/remove cart items and manage favorites (needs your own browser session cookie).
- Repository: https://github.com/mohammad-abbasi-sh/hepsiburada-mcp
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/hepsiburada-mcp/
- Version: 0.2.0 — health: verified — last checked: 2026-11-18 — in the catalog since: 2026-11-07
- Install: `claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user hepsiburada -- uvx hepsiburada-mcp`
- Page: https://mohammad-abbasi-sh.github.io/turkey-mcp/#/en/tool/hepsiburada-mcp

### Tools (12)

- `hepsiburada_search`: Search products by keyword, sort by price or relevance
- `hepsiburada_product_detail`: Detail of one product: price, stock, seller, GTIN, highlights
- `hepsiburada_list_categories`: The 9 top categories with URLs and ids
- `hepsiburada_price_stats`: Price stats for a query: min/median/mean/max in TRY
- `hepsiburada_product_reviews`: Recent customer reviews: author, rating, text, date
- `hepsiburada_view_cart`: View your cart: items, quantities, prices (TRY)
- `hepsiburada_add_to_cart`: Add a product to your cart (confirm required)
- `hepsiburada_remove_from_cart`: Remove one item from your cart (confirm required)
- `hepsiburada_update_cart_quantity`: Change a cart item's quantity (confirm required)
- `hepsiburada_list_favorites`: List your favorite product SKUs
- `hepsiburada_add_favorite`: Add a product to favorites (confirm required)
- `hepsiburada_remove_favorite`: Remove a product from favorites (confirm required)
